entities.name: Kentsu
entities.description: The imperial army of the Empire of Madara on Dominaria, vast and powerful, defeated only once in its first 400 years.

entities.name: Empire of Madara
entities.description: Empire on Dominaria served by the kentsu.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Emperor of Madara in the last year of whose reign the kentsu was defeated.

entities.name: Ayesha Tanaka
entities.description: Merged with Argenti's forests via the Sylvan Library and defeated the kentsu.

entities.name: Shasido Mayasi
entities.description: Former kentsu general defeated by Tetsuo Umezawa who became a hermit on Kusho.

entities.name: Tetsuo Umezawa
entities.description: Imperial champion who defeated Mayasi.

entities.name: Marhault Elsdragon
entities.description: Kentsu general who served almost 20 years until killed by Jorgan Hage.

entities.name: Jorgan Hage
entities.description: Ærathi berserker enslaved by Overdark's magic, who murdered Elsdragon and became general.

entities.name: Ramses Overdark
entities.description: Imperial regent who used black magic to enslave Hage and replace Elsdragon.

entities.name: Kolo Meha
entities.description: Bogardan mage and kentsu demolition expert who later served Tetsuo.

entities.name: Barktooth Warbeard
entities.description: Officer who led the Kusho occupation, killed and replaced by Halfdane.

entities.name: Halfdane
entities.description: Shapeshifter who replaced Warbeard as an infiltrator.

entities.name: Commander Hrotgha
entities.description: Ærathi officer whose men were killed by Wasitora at Umezawa Manor.

entities.name: Commander Gunamo
entities.description: Ærathi commander torn in two by killer vines.

entities.name: Sergeant Chada
entities.description: Sole survivor of Gunamo's forces.

entities.name: Commander Orai Daiyeta
entities.description: Ordered to raze Sekana; killed by Xira Arien.

entities.name: Xira Arien
entities.description: Killed Daiyeta for bleeding on her dress.

entities.name: Wasitora
entities.description: Whose kittens destroyed Daiyeta's battalion.

entities.name: Sylvan Library
entities.description: Site Tanaka used to merge with the forests of Argenti.

entities.name: Argenti
entities.description: Island of the Edemi Islands with forests.

entities.name: Kusho
entities.description: Island with deadly coral reefs occupied by the kentsu.

events.summary: The kentsu is sent to oppress an uprising on the Edemi Islands and quickly occupies Kusho and pillages Argenti.
events.quote: The kentsu were sent out to oppress an uprising on the

events.summary: Ayesha Tanaka merges with Argenti's forests and defeats the kentsu, strangling soldiers in their armor and enhancing Kusho's reefs.
events.quote: Tanaka animated the leather in the soldiers' uniforms, strangling them in their armor.

events.summary: Shasido Mayasi loses to Tetsuo Umezawa for the imperial champion title and lives as a hermit on Kusho.
events.quote: he chose to live out his life as a hermit on Kusho

events.summary: Overdark has Hage murder Elsdragon and promotes Hage to general once regent.
events.quote: Overdark wanted Elsdragon replaced by someone he could control more easily

events.summary: Warbeard is killed and replaced by the shapeshifter Halfdane.
events.quote: Warbeard was killed and replaced by the shapeshifter

events.summary: Gunamo is torn in two by killer vines; Chada survives by running.
events.quote: Gunamo was torn in two by killer vines

events.summary: Daiyeta's battalion is destroyed by Wasitora's kittens, and Xira Arien kills him.
events.quote: His battalion was destroyed by Wasitora's kittens.
